## What's free

14-day trial with $20 credit (no card), plus $30 when billing details are added; then pay-as-you-go CDN from $0.01/GB in Europe and North America

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://bunny.net/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Low-cost paid CDN, storage and DNS once the trial ends. Unused trial credit is removed when the trial ends.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
